messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — collecting the leadership Qs so we can publish a short customer-facing FAQ. Keeping it tight.

alex: 1) If you had to explain our mission to a non-technical exec in one sentence, what would you say?

nora: "We make inference predictable and economical so teams ship LLM features without surprise ops or cost regressions." Short and benefit-led.

jamal: Add the multi-environment bit when talking to infra folks: hosted, dedicated, private — same API, same controls.

alex: 2) One-liner vs hyperscaler endpoints for sales decks?

lee: Hyperscalers give model hosting; Redwood gives a production runtime with operational levers (batching/caching/quant) + rollout and observability. Engineers can tune unit economics without rebuilding infra.

nora: Include a quick example: "We reduced token cost by ~30% for a chat workload via batching + prefix cache in a week." Concrete wins help.

alex: 3) Messaging: should hero copy be "build vs buy" or "managed inference"?

jamal: For engineers, lead with "build vs buy". For broader marketing, phrase as "production-ready inference that preserves control" — signals managed but not opaque.

alex: 4) Competitor comparisons: direct naming OK anywhere?

lee: Avoid vendor naming on hero/TOF content. Create a gated appendix with explicit rows: Cloud AI endpoints, open runtimes, and self-hosted stacks. That appendix can include TCO examples and latency tradeoffs for SEs.

legal-bot: Reminder: any anonymized customer benchmark used publicly must be pre-cleared by Legal (send to #legal).

alex: 5) Product priority this quarter that best signals strategy execution?

nora: Ship the persona -> deployment playbook + public benchmark harness (runnable by prospects). If sales can hand a prospect a benchmark run and a playbook, it's huge.

jamal: Also: token-level cost breakdown in Console for customers. That operational visibility is a strong differentiator.

alex: 6) What public metric(s) can marketing show safely?

lee: Publish a reference p95 latency for a standard prompt size and a sample per-token cost range for a known config. Keep SLO attainment internal.

alex: 7) Can we publish a short FAQ/blog from this thread?

nora: Yes — keep it < 700 words, include one anonymized benchmark sentence, and link to a technical appendix. I'll coordinate with Marketing + Legal.

ops-bot: all-hands recording and slides uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/all-hands/3951234567 (slides: persona-playbook-draft.pdf)

alex: Action items: @nora to draft FAQ, @lee to prepare benchmark blurb and the appendix skeleton, @jamal to scope Console cost telemetry sprint. Tagging owners and closing thread after follow-ups. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
